svg.text: point_sets / cell_sets are dict views over them

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: side entries are (global cell, local facet)

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: A Mesh is points plus a list of homogeneous cell blocks. Every array describing cells is a LIST with exactly one entry per block, in block order:

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: the one-array-per-block invariant every operation preserves (an op writing cell_data emits NumCellBlocks() arrays; an op reading one checks the count).

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Point data is one array aligned to points; field data is whole-mesh. Regions address cells by their global block-major index, so a region survives

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: every operation that carries a cell map (detail/region_remap.hpp owns that remapping). Data-name order is observable — it drives most writers'

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: on-disk field order — so every backend returns sorted names.
